[[Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles/Legends|Ayelixe/Krongbing Textile's]] '''mountaineer armor''' was a type of armor that made it easier to navigate mountainous terrain.<ref name="EtU" />

==Description==
The mountaineer armor consisted of a one-piece [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]], [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], [[Boot/Legends|boots]], and a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]]. The armor was was light and flexible, and was made from tear-resistant textile. It featured [[FrictionGrip/Legends|FrictionGrip]] on the gloves and soles, and it was reinforced by impact-resistant [[Polymer/Legends|polymer]] pads. The armor was equipped with a [[Climbing harness|climbing and support harness]]. It could also be equipped with a multitude of accessories, such as [[oxygen tank]]s.<ref name="EtU" />
